ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

2. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

4. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 56

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

8. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 2
   C. 10
   D. 25

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 40
   C. 30
   D. 75

10. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

12. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 5
   C. 13
   D. 12

13. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

16. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

20. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

21. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 8

22. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

23. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

24. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
